---
title: "Questionnaire"
---

The list of questions asked and the choices shown. Per-question breakdowns are
linked from the sidebar under **Responses**.

## Basic demographic information (Q01–Q11)

Basic demographic information of the respondents. Workplace and
birthplace/hometown were asked separately. All questions were mandatory but
included a "Prefer not to answer" option.

- Q01 Age
- Q02 Gender identity
- Q03 Workplace
- Q04 Hometown
- Q05 Job title
- Q06 Research domain
- Q07 Research type
- Q08 Research years
- Q09 Career satisfaction
- Q10 Hours
- Q11 Session sign-up

## Status of the group you belong to (Q12–Q16)

The actual status of the group to which the respondent belongs. "Group" refers
to laboratories at universities, working groups within collaborations, etc.

- Q12 DE&I of the group
- Q13 Female ratio
- Q14 Thoughts on the female ratio
- Q15 Good-practice examples
- Q16 Group concerns

## Awareness of individuals (Q17–Q22)

How individuals feel about DE&I initiatives.

- Q17 DE&I (individual)
- Q18 Agree / disagree
- Q19 Science interest
- Q20 Individual concerns
- Q21 What hinders DE&I
- Q22 Remarks
